data.name: SetupWelcomeTitle
data.value: Let's connect RouterTray to your router

data.name: SetupWelcomeSubtitle
data.value: This five-step guide will create your first router profile and explain everything needed for a working connection.

data.name: SetupAddProfileWelcomeTitle
data.value: Let's add another router to RouterTray

data.name: SetupAddProfileWelcomeSubtitle
data.value: This five-step guide will create a new router profile and run the same connection and device checks as initial setup.

data.name: SetupWelcomeRouterTitle
data.value: Connect this PC to the router

data.name: SetupWelcomeRouterDescription
data.value: Use the Wi-Fi or Ethernet network of the Keenetic or Netcraze router you want to control.

data.name: SetupWelcomePoliciesTitle
data.value: Create access policies on the router

data.name: SetupWelcomePoliciesDescription
data.value: RouterTray switches existing policies without changing them. The wizard can register this PC as a home-network device.

data.name: SetupWelcomeCredentialsDescription
data.value: Use an administrator account, a dedicated user with Web interface access, or an access token on firmware 5.2 or newer.

data.name: SetupWelcomeSecurityNote
data.value: Your password or token is encrypted for the current Windows user and is never stored as plain text.

data.name: SetupRouterSubtitle
data.value: Give this connection a name, then let RouterTray find the router automatically or enter its address yourself.

data.name: SetupAutomaticAddressDescription
data.value: Best when the router is the gateway for this Wi-Fi or Ethernet network. No address needs to be saved.

data.name: SetupDetectingNetwork
data.value: Detecting the current network and gateway...

data.name: SetupRouterNotDetected
data.value: No gateway is visible right now. You can continue; RouterTray will try again when the network is available.

data.name: SetupManualAddressDescription
data.value: Use a complete HTTP or HTTPS address, for example http://192.168.1.1/.

data.name: SetupBindCurrentNetwork
data.value: Automatically use this profile on the current Windows network

data.name: SetupNetworkUnavailable
data.value: Windows could not identify the current network. You can select this profile manually from the tray.

data.name: SetupAuthenticationSubtitle
data.value: Choose one method. These credentials are used only to communicate with the router over your local network.

data.name: SetupCredentialsInstruction
data.value: For least privilege, create a separate router user and grant only Web interface access. An administrator account also works.

data.name: SetupPasswordMethodDescription
data.value: Works with supported Keenetic and Netcraze firmware using NDW2 or NDW4 authentication.

data.name: SetupTokenMethodDescription
data.value: Available on firmware 5.2 or newer. Paste the token generated by the router.

data.name: SetupDeviceSubtitle
data.value: The router must know this PC's MAC address before RouterTray can reliably assign access policies to it.

data.name: SetupTemporaryMacWarning
data.value: A locally administered MAC address was detected. Windows uses this format for random hardware addresses. If the address changes, the router will no longer recognize this PC and policy switching will not work correctly. Turn off “Random hardware addresses” for this Wi-Fi network, reconnect, and select “Check again”.

data.name: SetupTemporaryMacAcknowledge
data.value: I understand the risk and want to continue with the current MAC address

data.name: SetupDeviceRegistrationDescription
data.value: If the device is not registered yet, give it a recognizable name and add it to the router's home-network device list.

data.name: SetupDeviceNotChecked
data.value: Device registration has not been checked yet.

data.name: SetupCheckingDevice
data.value: Checking the MAC address on the router...

data.name: SetupDeviceRegisteredNoName
data.value: The device is already registered on the router.

data.name: SetupDeviceNotRegistered
data.value: This MAC address is not registered. Enter a name and select “Register”.

data.name: SetupRegisteringDevice
data.value: Registering the device and saving router settings...

data.name: SetupDeviceRegistrationRequired
data.value: Register the device on the router before continuing.

data.name: SetupTemporaryMacConfirmationRequired
data.value: Turn off the random MAC address and check again, or confirm that you understand the risk.

data.name: SetupDeviceNameRequired
data.value: Enter a device name for registration.

data.name: SetupDeviceNoMac
data.value: The active connection's MAC address could not be detected. Connect to the router and check again.

data.name: SetupDeviceRegistrationFailed
data.value: The device could not be checked or registered. Verify the router user's permissions and try again.

data.name: SetupFinishSubtitle
data.value: Review the profile and verify that RouterTray can see the registered device and load access policies.

data.name: SetupAutomaticAddressUnavailable
data.value: Automatically through the active network gateway

data.name: SetupNetworkNotBound
data.value: Select this profile manually from the tray

data.name: SetupConnectionCheckDescription
data.value: RouterTray will sign in and request the list of access policies without changing router settings.

data.name: SetupConnectionNotChecked
data.value: The connection has not been checked yet.

data.name: SetupConnectionSuccessNoPolicies
data.value: Connection established, but no access policies were found. Create policies in the router web interface.

data.name: SetupConnectionNoEndpoint
data.value: The router address is not available. Connect to the router network or go back and enter the address manually.

data.name: SetupConnectionAuthFailed
data.value: Authentication failed. Go back and check the login, password, or access token.

data.name: SetupConnectionUnreachable
data.value: The router could not be reached. Check the address and your network connection.

data.name: SetupConnectionTimeout
data.value: The router did not respond in time. Check the network and try again.

data.name: SetupConnectionApiFailed
data.value: The router responded, but its API could not be read. Check firmware support and permissions.

data.name: SetupConnectionDeviceNotRegistered
data.value: The connection works, but the current MAC address is no longer registered on the router. Return to the Device step.

data.name: SetupTrayHint
data.value: After setup, RouterTray will stay in the Windows notification area. Left-click its blue R icon to choose a policy; right-click for settings.

data.name: SetupCancelConfirmation
data.value: Setup is not finished, so RouterTray will not start. Exit now?

data.name: SetupAddProfileCancelConfirmation
data.value: Cancel adding this profile? The information you entered will not be saved.
